verdicts.reason: A is basically the portrait layout pasted into the middle of a square canvas. Everything sits in a narrow column with dead space on both sides, the legal line runs into the missing-asset placeholder at bottom right, and a background bubble lands on the body copy ('bottled'). B uses the width better with a 3-line headline and a 2-line body, and the legal line stays clear of the placeholder. However, B pushes the LIMITED EDITION and SMALL BATCH pills almost to the canvas edges, leaving large gaps around the unboxed AWARD WINNING label. Its placeholder box and the floating SUNSET SALE tag still look unfinished.
